desc: a flapping host link (fix-flap, 19.6.7): from @200 the proxy holds a's packets for 7 s at a time, 0.2 s apart (eight half-open cuts), then closes a's link for 30 s at @257.6. Each half-open cut's 4 s of silence start a grace and its end is a return; a's pads of the last ticks before each window come in time, so its fill streak ends every time. The host's absence debt (silence and grace count, the windows in time pay a little back) is about 50 s when the link closes: that grace gets the 20 s the debt leaves of 70 s instead of a fresh 60 s, and the instance ends (host_lost) inside the cut, about 78 s after the first cut, inside the bound of one absence (80 s); before, a fresh grace at every cut and a played on for good. b goes home, a after its reconnect
